about: Dataflow log of tools/build-uk-skeleton.mjs (skill cwplans-dataflow): operations, the fetches that made their input files, and one activity per run of an operation (inputs and outputs by SHA-256). Append-only; a run that the log already has is not repeated.

uk-boundaries.about: ONS generalised boundaries (clipped to the coastline) in the source grid: topology-keeping Douglas-Peucker per level, reprojected to WGS84 by the region projector, cut into quadtree cells; boundary and coast lines from the shared arcs; census population joined to districts

uk-protected-areas.about: National parks (ONS BGC) and national landscapes / national scenic areas: Douglas-Peucker per ring, reprojected by the region projector, cut into cells

uk-zoomstack.about: OS Open Zoomstack roads (motorways, A roads), railways and surface water: lines merged end to end by class and name, Douglas-Peucker, reprojected by the region projector, clipped to cells

uk-rivers.about: OS Open Rivers watercourse links grouped by name and connection into rivers, kept by total length per level, merged end to end, Douglas-Peucker, reprojected by the region projector, clipped to cells

uk-built-up.about: OS Open Built Up Areas by size per level, Douglas-Peucker per ring, reprojected by the region projector, cut into cells

uk-stations.about: NaPTAN active rail and metro / tram station areas as points (easting, northing by the region projector), names without the stop-type suffix

uk-gazetteer.about: Gazetteer by name key (OS Open Names kinds chosen, postcode districts as the mean of their postcodes, river names, ONS area names, Wikidata settlements where OS has none), place label points by level, and place cards from Wikidata (matched to OS names by DBpedia link, then by name within 8 km) with census population of the district

uk-manifest.about: manifest.json: layers, levels, files with bbox and feature counts, gazetteer and card files, sources with licences and fetch dates, credits
